note: Proposed ceilings for the data plane (Prompt 133). PROPOSALS: nothing reads them as a gate while tools/budget-policy.json says mode "exact", and the values are Carl's to adopt or change. A ceiling whose measuredBy is a browser probe is written down but has no measurement yet; that is reported as "not measured", never as a pass. Gzip figures are zlib's and differ by a few KB between Node versions; the gate is CI's (tools/budget-environment.mjs). Each tree-measurable ceiling is the measurement at 314ceb0b (Mac, Node 24, advisory) plus 10% rounded up to 1 KiB.
